cases.purpose: Record native mlockall lifecycle and same-process status/smaps. The resident requirement is VmLck plus the vDSO Rss, because mlockall does not lock that mapping.
cases.oracle: Native libc mlockall and munlockall with procfs. VmLck >= VmRSS is recorded only as evidence that it cannot hold: the vDSO is in VmRSS and not in VmLck. The requirement is VmLck + [vdso] Rss >= VmRSS.
cases.comparison: Independent diagnostic control; retain raw status and smaps. A failure of the vDSO-adjusted resident comparison in the candidate remains a failure.
